text.description_html:
Rocky Mountain CK257-B, Silicon Bronze Rail Cabinet Pull 8 Inch

The 8 Inch Rail Cabinet Pull features the industrial chic look that has gained in popularity over the years. It is made out of Silicon Bronze Metal. The Rocky Mountain Hardware Rail Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware you'll need to install it on your kitchen cabinets. It is has an 8 inch center to center length.

Features and Specifications of the Rocky Mountain Hardware Rail Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Silicon Bronze
  • Total Length: 8-5/8"
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Diameter: 1//2"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Clearance: 3/4"

Sold Individually. Special Ordered Item. No Returns
